name: Stars Design Group
old_description: From design to production and logistics to delivery, our integrated team of experts here in the U.S., and overseas offices, are dedicated to managing every step of the apparel manufacturing process.
about:
Stars Design Group is headquartered in St. Louis, Missouri. The company traces its origins to 1993 when Stars Apparel International, Inc. was founded in Turkey in response to retail and wholesale demand for high-quality, ethically responsible garments. In 2000, the group established its U.S. headquarters to centralize design, merchandising, and manufacturing oversight for its global operations.

The firm operates as a full-package apparel manufacturer, handling design, production, and delivery. Its U.S. design teams use 3D simulation software and a rotating library of fabrics and trims to develop collections. Manufacturing is coordinated through a network of 67 hand-selected factories across 14 countries, with third-party inspection teams conducting inline and post-production quality checks. A sales force covers 12 U.S. regions.

Stars serves lifestyle apparel brands ranging from established corporations to start-up labels and small retailers. Its client base spans the retail, wholesale, and housewares sectors, with an emphasis on brands seeking to maintain exclusive equity while expanding globally.

The company was created to fill a gap for ethically responsible manufacturing and differentiates itself through a strict code of conduct, long-standing factory relationships, and digital tools that accelerate design approval and reduce errors.
